ddl.name: people_shop_email_unique
ddl.where: "deleted_at" is null and "email" is not null

ddl.name: buddy_pair_members_one_subject
ddl.value: ("booking_id" is not null) <> ("crew_person_id" is not null)

ddl.name: certifications_identifier_present_unless_self_declared
ddl.value: ("identifier" is not null and length(btrim("identifier", E' \t\n\r\f\v')) > 0) or ("self_declared_at" is not null and "status" = 'pending') or ("issued_by_shop_at" is not null)

ddl.name: crew_assignment_requests_decided_together
ddl.value:
("decision" is null) = ("decided_at" is null)
        and ("decision" is null) = ("decided_by_person_id" is null)

ddl.name: executed_dives_exit_after_entry
ddl.value: "entered_at" is null or "exited_at" is null or "exited_at" > "entered_at"

ddl.name: gear_reservations_one_holder
ddl.value: ("booking_id" is not null and "person_id" is null) or ("booking_id" is null and "person_id" is not null)

ddl.name: imported_payment_history_amount_currency_pair
ddl.value: ("amount_cents" IS NULL AND "currency" IS NULL) OR ("amount_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "currency" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: last_minute_list_entries_range
ddl.value: "available_from" is null or "available_until" is null or "available_from" <= "available_until"

ddl.name: nitrox_certifications_identifier_present_unless_self_declared
ddl.value: ("identifier" is not null and length(btrim("identifier", E' \t\n\r\f\v')) > 0) or ("self_declared_at" is not null and "status" = 'pending') or ("issued_by_shop_at" is not null and "status" = 'pending')

ddl.name: people_anonymized_stays_removed
ddl.value: "anonymized_at" is null or "deleted_at" is not null

ddl.name: people_merged_stays_removed
ddl.value: "merged_into_person_id" is null or "deleted_at" is not null

ddl.name: people_merge_metadata_complete
ddl.value: ("merged_into_person_id" is null and "merged_at" is null and "merged_by_person_id" is null) or ("merged_into_person_id" is not null and "merged_at" is not null and "merged_by_person_id" is not null)

ddl.name: shop_promo_codes_window
ddl.value: "starts_at" is null or "expires_at" is null or "starts_at" < "expires_at"

ddl.name: specialty_certifications_identifier_present_unless_unsighted
ddl.value: ("identifier" is not null and length(btrim("identifier", E' \t\n\r\f\v')) > 0) or ("self_declared_at" is not null and "status" = 'pending') or ("issued_by_shop_at" is not null and "status" = 'pending')

ddl.name: staff_credentials_renewal_after_issue
ddl.value: "issued_at" is null or "renews_at" is null or "renews_at" >= "issued_at"

ddl.name: trip_invitations_source_reference_check
ddl.value:
(
        ("source" = 'date_request' and "course_inquiry_id" is not null and "waitlist_entry_id" is null and "person_id" is null)
        or ("source" = 'waitlist' and "course_inquiry_id" is null and "waitlist_entry_id" is not null and "person_id" is null)
        or ("source" = 'direct' and "course_inquiry_id" is null and "waitlist_entry_id" is null and "person_id" is not null)
      )

ddl.name: waiver_records_medical_clearance_attributed
ddl.value:
("medical_cleared_at" is null) = ("medical_cleared_by_person_id" is null)
        and ("medical_clearance_document_url" is null or "medical_cleared_at" is not null)

ddl.name: waiver_records_medical_clearance_evidenced
ddl.value:
"medical_cleared_at" is null or "anonymized_at" is not null or (
        "medical_clearance_evaluated_on" is not null
        and ("medical_clearance_document_url" is not null
          or "medical_clearance_physician_name" is not null))
